title: Aorta wall tissue-specific differentially expressed genes for CAD cases/controls from STARNET bulk RNA-seq data (FDR=10%)
bodyHtml:
The plot and table below show tissue-specific differentially expressed genes for coronary artery disease (CAD) cases/controls from STARNET bulk RNA seq data for aorta wall (FDR=10%).

Only genes with adjusted p-value < 0.1 are shown here. Complete data are represented in the dataset DSR971CLJ at the Common Metabolic Diseases Genome Atlas.
